Please see below? Can you confirm if these will ship on 9/28? That's what I'm seeing for this item on your site. Thank you

Hello,

Any update on this order? Thank you.
Handed to the team · order carries no ship date; delay compensation for the Bitaxe customs group need

Hello,

Your three Bitaxe Gamma 602s are paid and haven't left yet. They're clearing customs as we speak and go out at the end of this week or early next week, so the 28th lines up with what I'm seeing. Sorry it has taken this long to get them moving.

Compensation for the delay is going out too. Abel on our team is picking that part up today, so keep an eye on your inbox for it.

Tracking comes to this address the moment they ship.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for the update. Much appreciated.

-Alex

Hi Sarah,

I received my order, thank you. Wanted to follow up regarding the mentioned compensation. I haven't received any additional emails regarding that. Thank you.

Alex H., still haven't heard anything. Can you confirm? Thanks.

Following up again

Hello,

I will follow up for the next few days. If I don't hear back by the weekend, I will be leaving negative reviews on trustpilot (and other applicable platforms) as well as posting my experience on Reddit so other people don't experience the same thing. This has been by far the worst purchasing experience I've had with a company. You sold me a product that was in stock at the time of purchase, it ended up not being in stock, I had to wait over a month, customer service was horrible during the whole wait, and all three of the 602s had bent/twisted heatsinks. I was able to remove the heatsinks and correct the bends, but I will not be purchasing from helium deploy in the future. I would hope there would be some sort of partial refund or discount for having dealt with this whole experience. I'll wait to hear back from you.

Hi Alex,

You're right to be annoyed. I told you compensation was coming and it never reached you, and that one is on me.

I've put a $50 credit back on this order for the wait. It goes to the card you paid with within 3 to 5 business days, and it's with the team now to release today.

On the heatsinks, I'm sorry all three came through bent. I've reported it so the packing gets fixed. If any of the units starts underperforming after what you had to straighten, this form gets you sorted without sending the whole lot back: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
